name: adapter-lexical-grammar-audit
description: Exact-turn test of a completion-audit reminder that accepted lexical grammars are not canonical serializers.
remedy: [lexical-contract-audit] The task names accepted string languages. Treat them as languages, not canonical serializers: "trimmed" means surrounding whitespace remains valid, "case-insensitive" means mixed case remains valid, and an "unsigned decimal-integer string" includes leading-zero forms such as "007" unless canonical form is explicitly required. Compare the current accepting regexes and parsers against those named valid spellings now; correct any narrowed boundary, then rerun verification.
